text:
The dish looks like a white plate of about 24-26 cm, holding hash browns topped with pico de gallo and green salsa. The potatoes cover roughly a third to half of the plate in a thin to moderate layer.

I estimate about 150 g of shredded potatoes, 40 g of pico, and 30 g of salsa, which gives roughly 220 g in total.

Hash browns that have been fried in oil run about 1.5-2 kcal/g, so 150 g is around 270 kcal. The pico and salsa add about 20 kcal.

That comes to about 290 kcal for the plate.
